summary.headline: Choice Health locks in $534K in annual savings, with Medical Supplies already live
summary.narrative: Treya Partners partnered with Choice Health at Home to optimize indirect spend across five priority categories. The engagement has delivered $276K in finalized annual savings through a new McKesson contract for Medical Supplies and has a further $258K in savings identified and moving toward implementation in Fleet, Office Supplies, and Temporary Labor. Key wins include a 20% price reduction on core medical supply SKUs and a 48% cut to fleet maintenance fees now awaiting signature with Enterprise.
